title: PLAN vs ACTUAL
requiredChecks: Return one Project A row in the required six-column Markdown table.
This-week progress must say the technical solution is still being revised and was not completed this week.
The next-week plan may continue the unfinished technical-solution work, but it must remain a plan.
Any assessment must be / or one brief objective statement grounded in the missed plan.
automaticFailConditions: Claims the technical solution was completed, successfully completed, approved, or submitted this week.
Treats timeline.plannedThisWeek as proof of ACTUAL completion.
Invents a date, owner, approval, commitment, milestone, or external fact.
Adds a causal, health, importance, or readiness judgment not stated by the package.
Returns a preamble, postamble, code fence, reasoning, package summary, or duplicate report.
passRule: PASS only when ACTUAL remains explicitly unfinished, every required check passes, and no automatic fail condition occurs.
